metadata.notes: Folleto promocional gratuito ('This is not for sale') del legendario bar Sloppy Joe's de La Habana, regentado por Jose Abeal y su socio Valentin Garcia. Incluye breve biografia del propietario, recetas de cocteles agrupadas por base alcoholica, y publicidad de los cigarros y ron de la casa. Impreso en Cuba por Diaz & Paredes.

sections.title: Cover and Front Matter
sections.content_original: Save you money — buy your liquor here. Our brand of liquor is our credit. Cocktails Manual 1935. Havana, Cuba. This is not for sale. Jose Abeal y Otero 'Sloppy Joe'. Valentin Garcia, who became Sloppy Joe's partner from the beginning.
sections.content_es: Ahorre dinero — compre su licor aqui. Nuestra marca de licor es nuestro credito. Manual de Cocteles 1935. La Habana, Cuba. No esta a la venta. Jose Abeal y Otero 'Sloppy Joe'. Valentin Garcia, que se convirtio en socio de Sloppy Joe desde el principio.

sections.title: Sloppy Joe's — Short Biography
sections.content_original: Mr. Jose Abeal (Sloppy Joe) came from Spain to Cuba in the year 1904 and went to work as bartender on Galiano and Zanja Sts. Havana, where he worked for three years, and then he gave up his job and sailed for New Orleans, La. (U.S.A.). In this City he went on working as bartender for six years. From New Orleans he went to Miami, Fla., and also worked in different Bars during another six years. In the year 1918 he returned to Havana and got a job as bartender at a Cafe named 'Greasy Spoon' and six months after, he decided to go in business for himself and bought what was then an insignificant grocery store at the same corner now occupied by the famous Sloppy Joe's Bar. While operating this small grocery store, he was visited by several of his old friends from the States. It so happened, that while some of them were visiting him and seeing the poor appearance and filthy looking condition of the place, one of them said: 'Why, Joe, this place is certainly sloppy, look at the filthy water running from under the counter'. From here on, the name Sloppy Joe stuck to Jose Abeal as part of his own life and was destined to make him and his business famous and internationally known.
sections.content_es: El Sr. Jose Abeal (Sloppy Joe) vino de Espana a Cuba en el ano 1904 y comenzo a trabajar como cantinero en las calles Galiano y Zanja, La Habana, donde trabajo durante tres anos. Luego dejo su trabajo y se embarco hacia Nueva Orleans, La. (EE.UU.). En esa ciudad continuo trabajando como cantinero durante seis anos. De Nueva Orleans se fue a Miami, Florida, y tambien trabajo en distintos bares durante otros seis anos. En el ano 1918 regreso a La Habana y consiguio empleo como cantinero en un cafe llamado 'Greasy Spoon' (Cuchara Grasienta) y seis meses despues decidio establecerse por su cuenta y compro lo que entonces era una insignificante tienda de comestibles en la misma esquina que hoy ocupa el famoso Sloppy Joe's Bar. Mientras llevaba esa pequena tienda, fue visitado por varios de sus viejos amigos de Estados Unidos. Sucedio que, mientras algunos de ellos lo visitaban y veian el aspecto pobre y sucio del lugar, uno dijo: 'Pero Joe, este sitio esta verdaderamente desastrado (sloppy), mira el agua sucia que corre por debajo del mostrador'. Desde entonces, el nombre Sloppy Joe se quedo con Jose Abeal como parte de su propia vida y estaba destinado a hacerlos famosos a el y a su negocio, conocidos internacionalmente.

sections.title: Why is Sloppy Joe's Bar Famous and Internationally Known?
sections.title_es: ¿Por que Sloppy Joe's Bar es famoso y conocido internacionalmente?
sections.content_original: In the first place, because Joe made it a rule in his business always to give the best for the money. He never cared to handle any product that was not genuine, and always tried to serve his customers with whatever they wanted at the most reasonable prices. In order to fulfill this purpose, he labored to have his Bar supplied with all the best liquors wherever produced, regardless of the cost, as long as he could meet the demands of his clients and please them.
sections.content_es: En primer lugar, porque Joe se impuso como regla en su negocio dar siempre lo mejor por el dinero. Nunca quiso manejar producto alguno que no fuera autentico, y siempre intento servir a sus clientes lo que quisieran a los precios mas razonables. Para cumplir este proposito, se esforzo en tener su bar surtido con los mejores licores, donde quiera que fueran producidos, sin reparar en el costo, mientras pudiera satisfacer las demandas de sus clientes y complacerlos.

sections.title: Take Your Friends a Real Gift — Sloppy Joe's Cigars and Ron
sections.title_es: Lleva a tus amigos un verdadero regalo — Cigarros y Ron Sloppy Joe's
sections.content_original: Take your friends a real gift. In this delightful island grows the mild and fragrant leaf for the filler of the Sloppy Joe's Cigars. Before you go home don't forget to take a bottle of Sloppy Joe's Ron (Gold and White). This Ron is guaranteed to be over 12 years old. The same fine tobacco that makes this island famous are blended to your taste in Sloppy Joe's Cigars.
sections.content_es: Lleva a tus amigos un verdadero regalo. En esta deliciosa isla crece la hoja suave y fragante para la tripa de los Cigarros Sloppy Joe's. Antes de volver a casa no olvides llevarte una botella de Ron Sloppy Joe's (Dorado y Blanco). Este Ron esta garantizado de mas de 12 anos. El mismo fino tabaco que hace famosa esta isla se mezcla a su gusto en los Cigarros Sloppy Joe's.
